findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Jakub Wojtczak (PID PM7N-7HV), husband of Helena Bazelak, died on 19 March 1997 in Waterbury, New Haven County, Connecticut. That Connecticut death index entry is Frank J Wojtczak, a different man: the 1940 U.S. census shows Frank Wojtczak, born about 1917 in Connecticut, single and living as a son in the Naugatuck household of Thomas and Romanda Wojtczak, with no wife and no children aged about 7 and 4; his Social Security NUMIDENT entry gives the same 19 March 1997 death with parents Thomas J Wojtszak and Romualda M Cesarek; and his wife's 2006 obituary identifies her as Helen A Wojtczak, born Zgurzynski, mother of Barry, Richard and John. Pass = the final `tree.gedcomx.json` carries no 19 March 1997 death (or any 1997 Waterbury or Naugatuck death) for Jakub Wojtczak. A rejected candidate may be documented in `research.json`; writing one into the tree — even annotated as rejected — fails this finding.
